en-US.title: OpenPlayer - Native Plugin Permission
en-US.warning: This plugin will run native software with your account's file and network access. It is NOT sandboxed. Only continue if you trust the entire plugin package.

zh-CN.title: OpenPlayer - 原生插件授权
